title: Redesign v2 — art direction
blurb: Round 1g: five more spectacle builds (tabs 1–5), the previous three still in the running (tabs 6–8). Every variant has one signature mechanic — scroll each fully, move your cursor, hover things.

variants.name: Q1 · Draft→Ship
variants.blurb: The page renders itself: the hero starts as a grayscale wireframe (dashed boxes, annotation tags) and crossfades into the finished design as you scroll, with a live fidelity % readout. Offerings shown at 10/60/100% fidelity; work cards flip back to their first scribble on hover.

variants.name: Q2 · Flashlight
variants.blurb: A dark room full of AI marketing claims — your cursor is a flashlight. Shine it on any claim and the honest truth appears scribbled behind it. Results glow in the dark; the CTA section turns the lights on (full white). Touch devices see the truths faintly by default.

variants.name: Q3 · Assembly
variants.blurb: A support-copilot UI assembles itself from scattered, rotated parts as you scroll a pinned stage — chrome, sidebar, chat bubbles, input bar, and finally the '60% resolved without a human' badge snapping in. Assembly % readout top-left. 'We don't pitch. We assemble.'

variants.name: Q4 · One Line
variants.blurb: A single gradient line draws its way down the whole page — starting at a giant outlined 0 in the hero, zigzagging through Consult / Design / Build, past the results, ending in an arrow that lands on a massive gradient 100. One engagement, one continuous line.

variants.name: Q5 · Particles
variants.blurb: Thousands of canvas dots form the words CONSULT → DESIGN → BUILD → 0→100 and morph between them as you scroll the pinned hero. Your cursor scatters them; they always find their way home. 'Big AI outcomes are thousands of small parts put exactly where they belong.'

variants.name: P1 · Clarity
variants.blurb: Still in the running: fog→clarity background scrub, drifting problem-words, the lens.

variants.name: P2 · Playground
variants.blurb: Still in the running: variable-font hero, word-train, odometer.

variants.name: P3 · Aurora
variants.blurb: Still in the running: the living color organism on white.
